author: Paulus Silentarius
title: Descriptio Sanctae Sophiae (Description of Hagia Sophia)

sources.source: Paulus Silentarius, Descriptio Sanctae Sophiae. PG 86b (Migne). Also Friedländer 1912 Teubner edition. De Stefani 2011 Teubner edition available.
sources.notes: Greek text locked from PG 86b / Friedländer 1912. Ekphrasis of Hagia Sophia recited 563 AD. 1046 hexameter verses.

sources.source: Lethaby, W.R. & Swainson, H. The Church of St. Sophia Constantinople. London: Macmillan, 1894. Chapter III: The Descriptive Poem of Paul the Silentiary, Parts 1 and 2. pp. 35-52.
sources.notes: Lethaby & Swainson 1894 is PD English reference for densify. New English must be from Greek, not copied from Lethaby.
